f.title: Send Specific AR follow-up questionnaires for Italian RNF cases to the local PV officer named as sender
f.statement: Where a company wishes to send a specific adverse reaction follow-up questionnaire (Specific AR FUQ, approved by regulators and provided for in the RMP) for a suspected ADR report downloaded from EudraVigilance that originates from the Italian National Pharmacovigilance Network (RNF), it shall contact directly the local pharmacovigilance officer (RLFV) shown in the report's 'sender' section, whose contact details are in the RNF directory and on the AIFA website.
f.applicability: ICSRs originating from the Italian RNF and downloaded from EudraVigilance, where a Specific AR FUQ applies
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Local PV interfaces

rows.quote: Nel caso in cui l'Azienda farmaceutica dovesse inviare uno Specific AR FUQ per una scheda di segnalazione di sospetta reazione avversa scaricata da Eudravigilance e proveniente dalla RNF, dovrà contattare direttamente il Responsabile locale di farmacovigilanza (RLFV) riportato nella scheda stessa, alla sezione "sender"
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Where the pharmaceutical company needs to send a Specific AR FUQ for a suspected adverse reaction report downloaded from EudraVigilance and originating from the RNF, it shall contact directly the local pharmacovigilance officer (RLFV) indicated in the report itself, in the "sender" section

f.title: Pre-fill Specific AR FUQs with known data and send them already translated into Italian
f.statement: To encourage reporters to provide the information requested and help them gather missing data, AIFA recommends that companies pre-fill the questionnaires with the information already received and, above all, send them to the RLFV already translated into Italian.
f.applicability: Specific AR FUQs for Italian RNF cases
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Local PV interfaces

rows.quote: si raccomanda di precompilare tali questionari con le informazioni già ricevute e soprattutto di inviarli ai RLFV già tradotti in lingua italiana.
rows.review_note: Review: national language expectation. Level Recommended ('si raccomanda'). Double-check: quote proves level and content; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: it is recommended to pre-fill these questionnaires with the information already received and above all to send them to the RLFVs already translated into Italian.
